newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq ends with marginal gain enough for new high.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq ends with marginal gain enough for new high.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks barely made it to a fifth record close this month after a rough day which saw a lot of activity in bellwether high technology issues.
Analysts said shares of Microsoft Corp, Intel Corp, Applied Materials Inc and Cisco Systems Inc were initially down on concerns that company earnings may not justify record-high share prices.
But some high techs reversed strongly, leading the Nasdaq Composite Index higher in the last hour of trading.
The Nasdaq Composite Index unofficially gained 0.8 points at 1281.2 while declines led advances by 2424 to 1874 on volume of 637 million shares.
The previous record was set yesterday, when the Index rose 6.01 to 1280.37.
Intel was up 2-1/4 at 123-3/4, Microsoft was up 1/4 at 153-3/4, Applied Materials shed 1-1/16 to 39-6/19 and Cisco slipped 1/8 to 67-1/4.

Michael Metz, chief investment strategist at Oppenheimer & Co, said that "right now a lot of hot money is dashing in and out of these stocks. It's a way for portfolio managers to get exposed to the techs in a hurry."
